title: Face Tracking
description: Drop a video — the frame follows the face with a smooth, After Effects-style camera move.
dropLabel: Drop a video here or click to browse
dropHint: MP4, MOV or WebM — up to 10 minutes
zoomHint: Drag the dot onto the face you want followed (handy when there are several people). Drag the box to choose where that face sits in the final frame, and a corner or the slider to zoom. Zoom crops in and scales back up, so a little softness is normal.
coverageWarning: A face was visible in only {{percent}}% of the video — the camera holds or glides through the rest.
hint: Runs on your computer. One face is followed: the largest one, staying with it when others appear.
boxHint: Crop box: drag to move it, drag a corner to resize, or use the arrow keys and + / -
faceMarker: The face being followed — drag to move it
faceDrag: Drag onto the face you want to follow
